game.title: Psychonauts 2
game.blurb: Story-driven platformer about diving into other people's minds, from Double Fine Productions, released 2021-08-24. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Each mind and story turn, told as hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Favours
chapters.summary: The Family Camp, the Aquatodome, Queepie, Gisu and Lili's requests, talking to Milla and going back to the start.

chapters.title: Collectibles in the Minds
chapters.summary: Vaults, Figments, Emotional Baggage, Psychonauts assets, Stray Thoughts and revisiting brains.

chapters.title: Ranks and Badges
chapters.summary: Intern ranks up to 100, upgrading Badges and getting every upgrade.

chapters.title: Pins, Shopping and Supplies
chapters.summary: Pins, the Astral Wallet, Dream Fluff, PSI Pops, PSI Cards and Cores, and the Otto Shot.

chapters.title: Combat Tricks
chapters.summary: Turning enemies' attacks back on them, TK throws and Pyro.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 607080)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Psychonauts_2
Fandom (psychonauts.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://psychonauts.fandom.com/wiki/Psychonauts_2
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents are linked, but no subpage exists, so nothing was used. psychonauts.fandom.com answers the API under "Psychonauts 2", with about 41 linked articles, including mind names such as "Loboto's Labyrinth", "Hollis' Mind", "Compton's Cookoff", "PSI King's Sensorium" and "Lucrecia's Lament"; names only were looked at, nothing copied, and they were not used as chapters because the data gives no play order. Steam app 607080 is "Psychonauts 2". 20 of 57 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter, and their falling unlock rates (75% down to 20%) suggest they follow the story in order.
